summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for:
1. Floating Bulb System Overlay on Android 15 (WindowManager TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY, persistent foreground service, transparent touchable floating bulb icon, draggable with position storage, and compact popup control panel).
2. Voice Cloud Bridge on Android Phone for Amazon Alexa Smart Home Skill & Google Home Cloud-to-Cloud integration (Alexa.PowerController, Alexa.ColorController, Alexa.BrightnessController, Google OnOff, Brightness, ColorSetting traits).
3. Cloud Lambda / Cloud Functions webhook handlers and bridge client connection.
